description: A place where data enters from outside your control: HTTP bodies, webhooks, queue messages, files, environment variables.
Convert untrusted input into a typed value once at the boundary, so later code cannot receive an unchecked shape.
A Python library whose `BaseModel` classes build validators from annotations; validation runs in the compiled extension `pydantic-core`.
Pydantic's default: an input with an unambiguous conversion, such as `"17"` for an `int` field, is converted instead of rejected.
